BrochureContent.Content: Gallagher Auctioneers  bring to the market this three bedroom cottage in the scenic area of Arigna.  Accommodation comprises: entrance porch, kitchen/reception room, three bedrooms & bathroom.  The  property also benefits from a large shed. The house commands some wonderful views of the local countryside and Lough Allen.  The Arigna Mining Experience is only a 5 minute walk from this property.  The towns of Drumshanbo & Carrick on Shannon is located a short distance with an array of amenities and facilities.  The property is in need of some updating.  For all viewings please contact Gallagher Auctioneers on 0719621000
